blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has ordered a fresh review of the country’s economic growth targets for 2026 and 2027 as the government faces the prospect of another downward revision following the economy’s disappointing performance in the third quarter. The Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC) will meet on Dec. 1 to reassess the country’s macroeconomic assumptions and targets, including gross domestic product (GDP) growth, inflation and the peso’s exchange rate, Palace press officer Claire Castro said on Tuesday. The review comes just months after economic managers in June lowered the country’s 2026 GDP growth target to 3.5 percent to 4.5 […]...
